description: This Java class 'AppConfig' provides Spring Boot configuration, defining beans for in-memory UserRepository and RecipeRepository with seed data for users and recipes.

classes.name: AppConfig
classes.description: Configuration class setting up in-memory repositories with initial seed data.

methods.name: userRepository
methods.description: Creates and seeds the in-memory UserRepository with default users.

methods.name: recipeRepository
methods.description: Creates and seeds the in-memory RecipeRepository with default recipes linked to users.
